title: Synthetic Data Vault Examples
summary: A personal collection of Jupyter notebooks demonstrating SDV usage across single-table, multi-table, and sequential synthesis, including custom constraints and quality evaluation. The notebooks directly import and run SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, PARSynthesizer, and HMASynthesizer, along with its evaluation and constraint APIs, as tutorial-style examples.
needs: No named authors or affiliations found in README; repo appears to be a personal playground reproducing SDV's own tutorial notebooks.
